battle.name: 宋收復河、岷等州之戰
battle.brief: 熙寧六年正月至三月，宋神宗以新法為後盾，遣王韶總制熙河軍務，率秦鳳路兵與新附蕃兵分道出發，連下西夏的河州、洮州、岷州、疊州、宕州，拓地二千餘里，招附三十餘萬帳。攻城序列中，宋軍攜猛火油一類燃燒器械以焚柵燒舟；主導戰局者，仍是弩砲、楯車、糧道與招撫。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries:
這場戰爭是北宋對西夏邊疆戰爭的一次大規模進攻，時間在熙寧六年（一〇七三年）正月至三月之間。交戰的兩方是宋朝與西夏，但戰場上還有第三種力量：居於洮、岷一線的吐蕃部眾。

宋朝一方，是新法時期新建起來的西北邊防體系。熙寧五年取熙州之後，朝廷在秦鳳路的西面設熙州路，兵員以禁軍、廂軍為骨架，配以沿邊招募的土兵與歸附的蕃兵，統轄於熙河經略安撫司，由王韶總制軍務。糧秣自渭州、秦州一線的倉場沿渭水與洮水轉運，車隊、騾馬、腳夫組成一支龐大的後勤隊伍；堡寨、屯田、烽燧與斥候，則是王韶在熙寧年間一手布下的骨架。

西夏一方，是典型的党項軍國體制：全國由樞密院調度，監軍司分路設防，野戰主力為精於騎射的騎兵，攻城則倚重步卒持楯、扛雲梯、列衝車。這時西夏崇宗年少，實際執政的是梁太后，邊務多由樞府與監軍司直接調度，前線夏將的姓名多不見於宋人記載，只知其分守河、洮、疊、宕各州堡寨。

吐蕃一方，以木征部為主，名義上與宋敵對，實則在宋、西夏之間持兩端：宋軍所過之處，多數部眾棄寨而去或歸附，據守不退的少數部眾則被逐一討平。雙方在渭水與洮水之間的角力，本質上是牧場、城砦與道路的爭奪，捲入其中的還有大量自漢地邊州流亡的遊民與蕃漢混編的部眾。
countriesEn:
This war was a large-scale Song offensive against Western Xia on the frontier, fought between the first and the third month of the sixth year of the Xining era (1073). The two parties in the field were the Song and Western Xia, but a third force stood on that ground as well: the Tibetan communities living along the Tao and Min lines.

The Song side was a northwestern frontier system newly put together during the reform period. After Xizhou was taken in the fifth year of Xining, the court set up the Xizhou route west of the Qin Feng circuit. The troops had the imperial guards and the provincial guards as their skeleton, with locally recruited soldiers and surrendered fan troops added to them, all under the pacification commission of the Xihe circuit, with Wang Shao holding supreme command. Grain was shifted from the depots of Weizhou and Qinzhou along the Wei and Tao rivers; carts, mules and porters made up an enormous train behind the fighting force. The forts, the military farms, the beacon towers and the pickets were the skeleton that Wang Shao had laid down with his own hands throughout the Xining years.

The Western Xia side followed the classic Tangut military and administrative structure: the whole state was directed from the Privy Council, the army directorates held separate sectors, and the field strength consisted of cavalry skilled with the bow and the lance. For siege work they relied on infantry with shields, ladders carried on shoulders and battering rams. The Xia emperor Chongzong was a boy at this time and actual power lay with the Empress Dowager Liang; frontier matters were directed by the Privy Council and the army directorates, and the names of the Xia officers in the field are largely absent from the Song accounts, all that is known being that they held the forts of the various prefectures of He, Tao, Die and Dang.

The Tibetan side was led by Muzheng's clan. Nominally hostile to the Song, they in fact sat on the fence between Song and Xia: as the Song army passed, most of the clans abandoned their forts or came over, and only the few who held out were defeated one by one. The struggle along the Wei and Tao rivers was in truth a contest over pastures, fortresses and roads, and it drew in large numbers of refugees from the Han frontier prefectures as well as communities in which Han and Tibetan households were mixed.
people:
決定這一役走向的，是宋方以王韶為首的一批人。

王韶，字子純，韶州曲江人，出身書生而長於地略。熙寧元年上《平戎策》三篇，力主先取熙州以為進取之基：先築城置寨，再通道路、轉糧、募民屯田，把河湟變成可守可耕的永久基地，而不是一次性的遠征。他熙寧五年八月取熙州，六年乘勝取河、洮、岷、疊、宕五州，史稱其役「拓地二千餘里，招附三十餘萬帳」；熙寧七年六月病卒於軍中，年六十七。他不是靠一場會戰取勝，而是靠把城寨、糧道與部眾一點一點釘進這條走廊。

西夏方面，崇宗李乾順年少，攝政的梁太后主持朝政，邊軍的具體指揮多出自樞密院與監軍司。前線的夏將姓名散見於零星戰報而難以成系統，反覆出現的是西夏在河州、洮州一線的堡寨守將，其職責是守土城、護草場、斷宋軍糧道。有一點值得記住：西夏邊將多不與宋人正面爭鋒於野，而以屯守、騷擾、斷道為主，這是黨項軍的長處，也是其弱點。

朝廷層面，主持西北政策的是宰相王安石，熙寧開邊是他手中爭議最大的一張牌；韓琦、文彥博等老臣則力主持重，認為「師老糧乏」、得不償失。王韶之所以能年年推進，前提正是神宗趙頊的信任與國庫的支應。

吐蕃方面，木征是這一帶的首領，控弦之士以數十萬計，既不肯把草場拱手讓人，也不願獨力與宋、夏兩面作戰，於是在本戰役中多採觀望與局部抗爭，其部眾則大批為宋所招附。
peopleEn:
The men who decided how this campaign turned out were the Song commanders headed by Wang Shao.

Wang Shao, courtesy name Zichun, a native of Qujiang in Shaozhou, was a scholar by training and a master of ground. In the first year of the Xining era he presented the three memorials of the Plan for Pacifying the Rong, arguing that Xizhou should be taken first as the base of the advance: build the city and set up the forts, then open the roads, shift the grain, recruit settlers and open military farms, so that Hedong became a permanent base that could be held and farmed rather than a raid that ended with the army's departure. In the eighth month of the fifth year of Xining he took Xizhou, and in the sixth year he followed up his success by taking the five prefectures of He, Tao, Min, Die and Dang; the histories describe the campaign as opening up more than two thousand li of ground and bringing over more than three hundred thousand tents. He died of illness in camp in the sixth month of the seventh year of Xining, at the age of sixty-seven. He did not win by a single pitched battle; he won by driving the forts, the supply lines and the people into that corridor piece by piece.

On the Western Xia side, the emperor Chongzong, Li Qianshun, was a boy, and the Empress Dowager Liang, who took the decisions, held the court; the detailed command of the frontier troops lay with the Privy Council and the army directorates. The names of the Xia officers in the field appear only in scattered reports and are hard to assemble into a coherent list; those that recur are the commanders holding the forts along the He and Tao lines, whose task was to keep the earth-built towns, guard the pastures and cut the Song supply road. One point deserves recording: the Xia frontier officers rarely met the Song in open field, but relied on holding, harassing and cutting the road, which was the strength of the Tangut army and also its weakness.

At court, the man behind the northwestern policy was the chancellor Wang Anshi, and the opening of the frontier was the most disputed card in his hand; old ministers such as Han Qi and Wen Yanbo urged instead caution, holding that the army would tire, the grain run short and the whole thing would cost more than it gained. The precondition for Wang Shao's year-by-year advance was the trust of the emperor Shenzong, Zhao Xu, and the money of the treasury.

On the Tibetan side, Muzheng was the chief of this region, commanding hundreds of thousands of men under the string, unwilling to hand over the pastures for nothing and unwilling either to face Song and Xia alone; in this campaign he mostly watched and fought locally, while great numbers of his people came over to the Song.
kits:
卡面上的希臘火，是七世紀東羅馬帝國的國家機密：燃燒劑盛在銅管之中，由船上的操作手以唧筒推送，噴出的液體附在水面與牆根燃燒難熄；配方與器具由帝國中樞壟斷，配方隨沉船而失傳，最早的記載見於七世紀末對阿拉伯海軍的攻擊。熙河一帶是內陸高原戰場，沒有艦隊，沒有以海船為載體的噴射裝置，更沒有國家壟斷的燃燒兵種，兩者在地理與制度上相隔數千里，並無直接的承襲關係。

真正可以在此役中與之對照的，是同時期東方的燃燒與投射器械。熙寧年間距《武經總要》成書不過三十年，書中已載猛火油櫃一類的噴射器：油膏盛於皮櫃，前貫銅管，壓之即出，點燃後投向木柵、帆布、柴草與舟筏；火矢則是浸油箭頭配火藥引信，專用來燒敵方的攻城器械與糧車。各書對猛火油在熙寧戰役中的具體用法記載不盡一致，可以確定的是：北宋攻守器械之中確有猛火油櫃一類的燃燒器，熙寧年間西征的序列亦曾攜帶，而木構的柵牆、寨屋與水上的浮橋舟筏，正是它最合適的目標。

真正決定勝負的仍是弩與砲。神臂弓這類強弩提供遠程壓制，飛石與砲車打擊城頭及密集人陣；楯車（車上合板為盾）逼近牆根，撞竿、雲梯、對樓用於登城；守方以夯土城垣、木柵、壕溝、拒馬、鹿角與擂石應對，牆體缺口以泥袋填塞，來火則以沙土覆壓。軍馬是機動的基礎：宋軍以秦鳳、涇原一線的馬匹與沿邊蕃馬為主，夏人精騎與吐蕃騎兵則靠馬力在渭水河谷與高原草場之間轉戰。
kitsEn:
The Greek fire on this card was a state secret of the seventh-century Eastern Roman Empire: the burning charge was carried in bronze tubes, driven forward by an operator on the ship with a hand pump, and the liquid it projected caught on the surface of the water and at the foot of walls and burned with great difficulty in extinguishing. The formula and the apparatus were monopolised by the imperial centre, the formula was lost when the ship went down, and the earliest records date to the attacks on the Arab fleets at the end of the seventh century. The Xihe region was an inland battlefield on the plateau: there was no fleet there, no projection device carried aboard a ship, and no state-monopoly corps of flame. The two were thousands of kilometres apart in geography and in institutions, and there was no direct line of descent between them.

What can honestly be set against it in this campaign is the class of burning and projection devices of the East in the same period. The Xining era came barely thirty years after the Wujing Zongyao was completed, and that manual already describes the menghuoyougui, a projection device of burning fluid: grease held in a hide cylinder with a bronze tube fitted at the front, squeezed out and set alight, thrown at palisades, canvas, brushwood and boats; fire arrows, whose oil-soaked heads carried a gunpowder fuse, were used against the enemy's siege engines and baggage carts. The books differ in the detail of how the menghuoyou was actually used in the Xining campaigns, but what can be settled is this: the Northern Song siege and defence equipment certainly included projection devices of this kind, the expedition columns of the Xining years did carry them, and the wooden palisades and the timber buildings of the forts, together with the pontoon bridges and boats on the river, were exactly the targets they suited.

What really decided the fighting was still the bow and the artillery. Powerful drawn bows such as the Shenbi crossbow gave long-range suppression; stone-throwers and bombards struck the parapets and massed troops; the dunche (a cart with boards fitted together as a shield) was brought up to the foot of the wall, and battering rams, ladders and siege towers were used to mount it. The defenders answered with rammed-earth ramparts, wooden palisades, trenches, caltrops, deer-horn abatis and stones for rolling, filled gaps in the wall with sacks of mud, and covered down any fire that came at them with sand and earth. Horses were the basis of manoeuvre: the Song drew on the mounts of the Qin Feng and Jingyuan lines together with the fan horses of the frontier, while the Xia heavy cavalry and the Tibetan horsemen moved on horseback through the valleys of the Wei River and the pastures of the plateau.
tactics:
這場戰役的戰術骨架，是宋代邊防「築城—屯田—招撫—以堡寨為支點向前推」的方法，在戰場上則表現為分路並進、逢城必攻、遇部即撫的典型模式。

進攻是分路的。熙寧五年八月取熙州之後，宋軍在熙州分為數路：主力自熙州沿谷道與大夏河南岸南下河州，東路沿洮水河谷向洮、岷一線推進，另有一支轉向西南，指向疊州與宕州。各路皆以大隊隨行、以糧車自隨，遇堡寨則攻之，遇部眾則撫之，形成推進與綏靖同步的格局。

攻城用的是宋代標準的攻堅法。先以弩砲覆壓城頭與牆後，繼以楯車進抵牆根，拆毀木柵與城樓，再以撞竿、雲梯攀附。西夏的邊寨多為土築木柵而非磚石大城，故能擋住砲石，卻擋不住火攻與攻城器械：宋軍以猛火油與火矢燒毀木構、覆壓城頭的守軍，掩護雲梯接近；亦有記載稱宋軍在河州以舟筏載火順流而下，焚燒夏人用以斷渡的浮橋與舟艦。守方則在城外築壘、掘壕、列拒馬，把宋軍的攻城器械限制在壕溝之外，並以泥濘、覆沙對付油火。

招撫與戰鬥是同一件事的兩面。吐蕃與漢地邊民部眾，或降或走，縣官隨軍設置，量給牛種，編為屯田戶與蕃兵，願入軍伍者給弓刀、給田地。凡此說明宋廷在熙河並非只想打下城池，而是想留下一套能自我維持的行政與軍事架構；也正因如此，此役的勝負並非以會戰論，而是以誰能守住新得的土地論。
tacticsEn:
The tactical skeleton of this campaign was the Song method on the frontier — build the city, farm the land, pacify the people, and push forward with the forts as bases — and on the field it took the form of advance by several columns, assault on every city met, and pacification of every tribe encountered.

The advance was made in columns. After Xizhou was taken in the eighth month of the fifth year of Xining, the Song army split there into several: the main body went south from Xizhou along the valley roads and the bank of the Daxia River towards Hezhou, one column went east along the valley of the Tao River towards Tao and Min, and another turned south-west towards Die and Dang. Each marched with its main body and with its grain carts in its train, assaulting every fort it met and pacifying every group of people it met, so that advance and pacification went on together.

The siege followed the standard Song method of assault. Fire from the crossbows and the bombards first swept the parapets and the ground behind the wall; then the dunche carts came up to the foot of the wall to break down the palisade and the towers, and battering rams and ladders were brought against the masonry. The Xia frontier forts were mostly rammed earth with wooden palisades rather than great walled cities, and so they stood against stones but not against fire and siege engines: the Song burned the wooden structures with menghuoyou and fire arrows and smothered the defenders on the parapets while the ladders went up; there are also records that at Hezhou the Song sent burning rafts drifting down the river to burn the pontoon bridges and boats the Xia used to break the crossing. The defenders answered by building works and digging trenches outside the walls and planting caltrops to hold the Song engines beyond the ditch, and by muddying the ground and throwing sand over the oil fires.

Pacification and fighting were two sides of the same business. The Tibetan and Han frontier populations either surrendered or moved away; county officers marched with the army, cattle and seed were allotted, the people were registered as military-farm households and fan troops, and those willing to enlist were given bows, sabres and fields. All this shows that the Song court in the Xihe circuit did not merely want to take cities; it wanted to leave behind an administrative and military structure that could support itself. That is why the outcome of this campaign was not to be argued from any single battle, but from who could hold the land that had just been taken.
data:
時間：戰役在熙寧六年（一〇七三年）正月至三月間展開。熙寧五年八月取熙州是前哨，此役自熙寧六年正月發兵，至三月先後下河、洮、岷、疊、宕五州，設州置監則在同年秋冬。整條熙河線的開闢自熙寧元年《平戎策》獻上起，前後約五年。

地理：主戰場河州（西夏稱枹罕）在今甘肅臨夏，據黃河南岸積石關下，自熙州（今甘肅臨洮）南下約二百餘里；洮州在今甘肅臨潭，岷州在今甘肅岷縣，疊州在今甘肅迭部，宕州在今甘肅宕昌，距熙州多在三百里上下。渭水、洮水、大夏河三條水道是全線的骨架，糧秣與援兵皆循河谷而行。

兵力：宋軍以秦鳳路禁軍、廂軍為主力，輔以沿邊土兵與新附蕃兵，分數路作戰，單路兵力當在數千至萬餘人之譜，總數當在數萬量級；西夏方面以河、洮、疊、宕各州堡寨的守軍為主，總數亦在數萬一級。具體點名冊已佚，雙方所報多有誇大，只可作量級來看。

戰果：史載此役「拓地二千餘里，招附三十餘萬帳，獲牛羊馬以萬計」；所取城寨以數十計，部眾多以「帳」計（吐蕃、党項部族的計帳單位），其中多數為歸附而非戰歿。損失數字各書互有出入，難以核對，不作斷言。

後勤：熙寧年間新築的驛路、堡寨與屯田，使部分糧食可就地取用；但遠路各軍仍需自渭州、秦州運糧，冬季河西苦寒，車隊行進緩慢，這是宋軍必須速戰速取、不宜久拖的物質原因。
dataEn:
Timing: the campaign was fought between the first and the third month of the sixth year of the Xining era (1073). The taking of Xizhou in the eighth month of the fifth year was the advance post; the army set out in the first month of the sixth year and brought down He, Tao, Min, Die and Dang one after another by the third month, while the setting up of the prefectures and directorates followed in the autumn of the same year. The opening of the whole Xihe line ran from the presentation of the Plan for Pacifying the Rong in the first year of Xining and took something like five years.

Geography: the main field, Hezhou (called Fuhai by the Xia), lies in what is now Linxia in Gansu, on the south bank of the Yellow River below Jishi Pass, some two hundred li south of Xizhou (present-day Lintao in Gansu). Taozhou is in present-day Lintao, Minzhou in present-day Minxian, Diezhou in present-day Diebu and Dangzhou in present-day Dangchang, all of them around three hundred li from Xizhou. The Wei, the Tao and the Daxia rivers formed the skeleton of the whole line, and both the grain and the reinforcements moved along the valleys.

Strength: the Song army had the imperial and provincial guards of the Qin Feng circuit as its backbone, supported by frontier levies and newly surrendered fan troops, operating in several columns; each column was probably in the range of several thousand to a little over ten thousand men, and the total was of the order of tens of thousands. On the Xia side the strength was the garrisons of the forts of the various prefectures of He, Tao, Die and Dang, again of the order of tens of thousands. The muster rolls are lost, the reports of both sides are plainly exaggerated, and the figures can only be taken as orders of magnitude.

Results: the histories record that this campaign "opened up more than two thousand li of ground, brought over more than three hundred thousand tents, and yielded cattle, sheep and horses by the ten thousand". The towns taken are counted by the tens, and the people are counted by the tent, the accounting unit of the Tibetan and Tangut tribes; most of them came over rather than being killed in the fighting. The loss figures differ from book to book and cannot be checked, so no assertion is made about them.

Logistics: the roads, forts and military farms newly built in the Xining years allowed part of the grain to be taken locally, but the columns operating at a distance still needed their supplies shifted from Weizhou and Qinzhou; in the winter the cold of the Hexi corridor was severe and the cart trains moved slowly. That was the material reason why the Song army had to strike and finish quickly rather than fight a long war.
cause:
打起來的原因有三層。

最直接的一層是地盤與國策。宋朝自熙寧元年起推行開邊之策，王韶《平戎策》所畫的路線十分清楚：先取熙州，斷西夏與吐蕃的連絡，再取河、洮、岷、疊、宕，築城置監，募兵市馬，轉輸糧草，把河湟變成可屯可守的地區。這是一條以五六年為尺度的長線經營，而不是一場會戰可以解決的問題。西夏在熙寧五、六年正面承受這條線的推進，其河州與洮岷一線的堡寨，正是這條線上的第一道門。

第二層是西夏自身的處境。崇宗年少，梁太后攝政，內部又有主戰與主和之爭；熙寧年間宋夏在秦鳳沿邊開設榷場，互市不斷，而市易一旦中斷，夏人邊軍的馬匹與物資立刻吃緊。西夏很清楚：如果放任熙河被逐一奪取，遲早會與東面靈州的宋軍形成南北夾擊；因此守不住也要守，寧可把兵力押在土寨與塹壕上與宋軍比消耗。

第三層是中間的吐蕃。木征部控制的洮、岷草場與城砦，是西夏與宋朝都要爭取的緩衝帶；宋軍每進取一處，吐蕃就要失去一片牧場與一批部眾。木征既不肯坐視，也無力單獨對抗兩面，於是部分部眾選擇抵抗，更多部眾選擇歸附。這使戰役的走向並非宋夏兩家的單純對決，而是宋廷如何把「打」與「撫」並用的考驗。
causeEn:
There were three layers of reason behind the fighting.

The most direct layer is ground and national policy. From the first year of Xining the Song court pursued a policy of opening the frontier, and the line drawn in Wang Shao's Plan for Pacifying the Rong was plain: take Xizhou first to sever the link between Western Xia and the Tibetans, then take He, Tao, Min, Die and Dang, build cities, set up directorates, recruit soldiers, buy horses, shift the grain, and turn Hedong into ground that could be farmed and held. This was a long operation measured in five or six years, not something a single battle could settle. Western Xia bore the weight of that line directly in the fifth and sixth years of Xining, and the forts of the He and Tao-Min lines were the first gate on it.

The second layer is the position of Western Xia itself. Chongzong was a boy, the Empress Dowager Liang took the decisions, and within the state there was a standing argument between those who would fight and those who would make terms. Throughout the Xining years the Song and the Xia maintained regulated markets on the Qin Feng frontier, and when that trade was interrupted the Xia frontier troops at once went short of horses and supplies. Western Xia understood the arithmetic clearly: if the Xihe circuit were taken away one prefecture at a time, the Song would sooner or later close on Xia from the north and from the east at Lingzhou together. So the forts had to be held even if they could not be held for ever, and the Xia chose to match the Song in time and labour behind earthen walls and ditches.

The third layer is the Tibetans in between. The pastures and forts of the Tao and Min lines held by Muzheng's people were the buffer that both Western Xia and the Song wanted; every post the Song advanced upon cost the Tibetans a stretch of pasture and a band of their people. Muzheng would neither sit still nor take on both sides alone, so some of his clans fought and many more came over. The campaign was therefore not a simple duel between Song and Xia, but a test of whether the Song court could combine striking with pacifying.
impact:
此役的結果，是宋朝的熙河從一次探險式的推進，變成了一條有行政、有軍隊、有屯田的邊防線。河、洮、岷、疊、宕五州入宋之後，與先得的熙州連成一線，宋朝在唐宋以來首次在西夏的西南側取得可以駐紮的地區，打開了向青海方向的道路；此前唐蕃時期的邊境互市傳統，得以在宋夏夾縫中重新出現。

代價同樣明顯。熙河一線的城寨、屯田、驛路與軍費，長年在《宋史·食貨志》中被列為西北開支的大頭；王安石以熙河之功抵制朝中「開邊耗財」的攻擊，王韶的升遷與他身後的追贈，正是這場政治角力的結果。元豐四年（一〇八一）宋神宗再啟五路伐夏，熙河一路照例出師，卻與其餘各路配合生疏而大敗；元祐年間宋廷一度被迫割地求和，熙河線幾度緊張。真正把河湟收全、使之成為正式州郡，要到崇寧年間童貫、蔡挺經營河湟之後，湟、鄯、廓諸州才相繼歸宋。

技術史上也有一層意思。希臘火作為帝國壟斷的燃燒秘密，在十二世紀初走向絕跡；與此同時，東方的火矢、猛火油櫃與火藥器械正在各類戰場上普及。同一個歐亞大陸的兩端走上了不同的路：把燃燒劑做成祕密並壟斷它的做法，隨中央權力的削弱而失傳；把燃燒劑做成通用器械、靠大量配備與工匠制度取勝的做法，則隨着火藥與冶金條件的成熟而擴散。
impactEn:
The upshot of this campaign was that the Xihe circuit stopped being an exploratory push and became a frontier line with an administration, an army and military farms of its own. Once the five prefectures of He, Tao, Min, Die and Dang were in Song hands and joined to Xizhou, the Song for the first time since the Tang held ground on the south-west side of Western Xia where it could garrison men, and the road towards Qinghai was opened; the old border-trade tradition of the Tang and Tibetan period could revive in the crack between Song and Xia.

The costs were no less plain. The cities, farms, roads and army of the Xihe line were long listed in the Treatise on Revenue of the Song History among the great expenses of the northwest. Wang Anshi used the achievements of the Xihe campaign to answer the charges that opening the frontier drained the treasury, and Wang Shao's promotion and the honours after his death were the outcome of that political struggle. In the fourth year of the Yuanfeng era (1081) the emperor Shenzong launched the five-pronged offensive against Western Xia again, and the Xihe column marched as usual, but the coordination between the several armies was clumsy and the offensive ended in defeat. In the Yuanyou years the court was once forced to cede ground and seek terms, and the Xihe line was tense more than once. It was only after Tong Guan and Cai Ting worked on Hedong in the Chongning years that Huang, Shan and Guo were brought in turn under Song rule and Hedong became a settled group of prefectures.

There is a further sense in which this year matters to the history of technique. Greek fire, a burning secret monopolised by an empire, was running out by the early twelfth century; at the same time fire arrows, the menghuoyougui and gunpowder devices were spreading on battlefields of every kind. The two ends of the same Eurasian land were taking different roads: the practice of making a burning charge into a secret and monopolising it died out as central power weakened, while the practice of making it a general-purpose device, and winning by massing equipment and by the workshop system, spread as gunpowder and metallurgy improved.
result:
結果是宋軍攻下了河、洮、岷、疊、宕五州，盡復熙河之地。

具體經過是這樣的：熙寧六年正月，宋軍自熙州分道出發，主力南下河州，先以弩砲壓制城頭，再以楯車逼近、拆除木柵，以撞竿與雲梯登城；火矢與猛火油則用來燒毀木構、覆壓守軍，並對付夏人用於斷渡的浮橋與舟筏。河州既下，東路沿洮水取洮、岷，西路轉向疊、宕，各州堡寨多為土築木柵，遇火攻與器械即潰，宋軍數月之間連下五州。史稱其役「拓地二千餘里，招附三十餘萬帳，獲牛羊馬以萬計」。

戰後，朝廷在熙州置經略安撫司，以王韶總制河湟軍務，在新附之地設州、置監、募兵、轉糧，編戶、給田、授刀，把歸附部眾編為蕃兵與屯田戶。西夏失去了西南屏障，被迫退守蘭州、靈州一線，防守重心內縮；吐蕃木征部的處境也急轉直下，數年後率眾降宋，洮、岷一線盡入中原。

對宋廷而言，這一役證明了一件事：西北邊防不是靠一場會戰贏來的，而是靠築城、置監、屯田、招撫與糧道一件一件堆出來的。卡面這件兵器提醒的是同一時代的另一條線——拜占庭把燃燒劑做成帝國祕密，因而在專制權力鬆動時隨之失傳；東方把燃燒劑做成通用器械，雖然談不上祕密，卻也因此得以在每一次邊攻防戰中出現。
resultEn:
The result was that the Song army took the five prefectures of He, Tao, Min, Die and Dang and recovered the whole of the Xihe ground.

The course of it was as follows. In the first month of the sixth year of Xining the Song army set out from Xizhou in several columns, the main body moving south on Hezhou, first pinning the parapets with the crossbows and the bombards, then bringing the shield carts up to the foot of the wall to break down the palisade, and mounting with rams and ladders; fire arrows and menghuoyou were used to burn the wooden structures, to smother the defenders on the walls, and to deal with the pontoon bridges and boats by which the Xia meant to break the crossing. With Hezhou taken, the eastern column took Tao and Min along the Tao River and the western turned towards Die and Dang; the forts of these prefectures were for the most part rammed earth with wooden palisades, and against fire and siege engines they gave way, so that five prefectures fell within a few months. The histories describe the campaign as opening up more than two thousand li of ground, bringing over more than three hundred thousand tents, and yielding cattle, sheep and horses by the ten thousand.

Afterwards the court set up a pacification commission at Xizhou, with Wang Shao holding supreme command of the army in Hedong, and in the newly taken country established prefectures, directorates, recruitment and supply, registered the households, allotted fields, issued bows and sabres, and enrolled the surrendered communities as fan troops and military-farm households. Western Xia had lost its south-western screen and was driven back onto the Lingzhou and Lanzhou line, its defensive weight contracting inward. The position of Muzheng's Tibetans turned quickly as well; within a few years they surrendered to the Song, and the Tao and Min lines came wholly under Chinese rule.

For the Song court this campaign proved one thing: the northwestern frontier was not won in a single battle but piled up piece by piece out of cities, directorates, farms, pacification and supply lines. The weapon on the card points to another line of the same age — Byzantium made the burning charge an imperial secret and so lost it when the despotic power slackened; the East made it a general-purpose device, which was no secret at all, but precisely for that reason it was present at every siege and every defence on the frontier.
